q: A verifier is visiting our plant for our carbon inventory. What should we prepare?
title: Preparing for a verifier's site visit
short: Have the documents behind every number ready, the meters and weighbridge accessible, and the people who keep the records available. The verifier will trace a sample of figures from your report back to invoices, logbooks and meters, and check that what they see on site matches what the report describes.
audience: MSMEs getting their first GHG verification

ul: The inventory, with methods and factors.
Fuel and electricity invoices for the period.
Logbooks, stock registers and production records.
Calibration certificates for meters and weighbridges.
A walk through each emission source: boilers, DG sets, furnaces, refrigeration.
The person who enters data, to explain how it flows.
A quiet room and access to files.

p: Expect questions and requests for more evidence. Answer them in writing with the documents attached.

senseible: Senseible keeps every figure linked to its source invoice or bill with a fingerprint, so a verifier can trace a total back to the documents it came from.
